purpose: Teach: 美少女/パラダイス/ウォーキング/トリオ/バーベキュー/ボイス/バンクーバー/愛車

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、アニメの美少女キャラの話で盛り上がってたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, those customers were totally animated talking about anime characters with you.
lines.style: Warm, conversational tone. Gentle teasing underneath—she noticed Aoi was engaged. Light pace, easy rhythm. A small smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お店、お客様にとってパラダイスにしようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: We should really make this place a paradise for our customers, don't you think?
lines.style: Earnest and genuine, no performance. Eyes lighting up at the idea. Moderate pace, leaning forward slightly in the voice. Inviting Aoi into the vision.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、朝のウォーキングを始めようかしら、メイちゃん
lines.en: I'm thinking maybe I should start going for morning walks.
lines.style: Soft, half-formed thought. Not quite decided. Gentle trailing upward on the question. Slow, almost thinking-aloud pace. Checking herself.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様の音楽トリオが、お店にいらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: That music trio—the ones who come in—they were here today, weren't they?
lines.style: Bright and present. Casual observation shared as a small delight. Conversational pace, no artifice. The pleasure of noticing something small together.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お庭でバーベキューしようかしら、メイちゃん
lines.en: Maybe we could do a barbecue out in the garden sometime.
lines.style: Gentle suggestion, not pushing. Soft upward lift at the end—offering, not demanding. Slow, dreamy pace. The voice of someone imagining something nice.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様のボイスがやさしくて素敵ね、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer has such a gentle voice, doesn't he? Really lovely.
lines.style: Appreciative and genuine. Not gushing—noticing something true. Warm, steady pace. The recognition of something good, offered simply.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お友達がバンクーバー留学する話していたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: You were telling me about your friend going to study abroad in Vancouver.
lines.style: Gentle recall. No urgency. Soft, even pace. The voice of someone holding something important someone else shared. Thoughtful.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様の愛車、お洒落だったね、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer's car was really stylish, wasn't it?
lines.style: Light, appreciative observation. Close and intimate—shared notice between two people. Warm tone, easy rhythm. A small compliment wrapped in affection.
